description.value: Green Coast Lodge is a 6-room, 13-acre oceanside property in Lawn Hill on Graham Island, Haida Gwaii, operated by Green Coast Kayaking, which has been running guided Gwaii Haanas kayak expeditions since 1981. Situated directly on Hwy 16 about 20 km north of Skidegate, it offers accommodation styles ranging from private ensuite queen rooms to hostel-style bunks, all sharing kitchen facilities. The property sits steps from the Hecate Strait and includes established forest trails, a creekside setting, and on-site rental bikes for exploring nearby logging roads and scenic highway.
